newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek depos firm, forwards, bonds, ecu/drs flat.
newsitem.headline: Greek depos firm, forwards, bonds, ecu/drs flat.

text.p: Greek depos opened a tenth of a point higher across-the-board, forex forwards were little changed, bonds were frozen and ecu/drachma was hovering around 309.56/61 in lacklustre trade, dealers said.
"Depos are trading 10 basis higher on what seems to be tighter liquidity," said a dealer at a foreign bank. "Forex forwards are holding late Friday levels."
Bond prices were stable and trading volume was subdued, traders said. "There have been very few deals today and bond prices are holding," said a trader at a private bank.
Ecu/drachma opened around 309.50/55 from Friday's 309.60/65 close and firmed a bit to 309.56/61 in unexciting trading, traders said.

"Ecu/drachma is currently trading around 309.56/61 but it might ease later on," said a senior forex dealer at a foreign bank. "The 309.50 level is weak support with 309.25 being the strong support level."
The mark was quoted at 157.20/30 from Friday's 157.425 fix, the dollar at 274.24/34 drachmas from 275.500 and the ecu at 309.37/47 from 309.80 drachmas.
